definitions.explanation: A domesticated duck, typically white, raised for eggs, meat, or as a pet.

examples.japanese: アヒル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{池|いけ}→池：00848_ike⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泳|およ}いでいる→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧。
examples.english: Ducks are swimming in the pond.

examples.japanese: アヒル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧「ガーガー」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{鳴|な}く→鳴く：04388_naku⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧アヒル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{餌|えさ}→餌：01886_esa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やっている→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: The child is feeding the ducks.

notes:
アヒル refers specifically to domesticated ducks, as opposed to wild ducks (⟦{鴨|かも}→鴨：17740_kamo⟧). Usually written in katakana, though the kanji ⟦{家鴨|あひる}→家鴨：noentry⟧ exists (literally "house duck").

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{鴨|かも}→鴨：17740_kamo⟧: wild duck (also used in cooking: ⟦{鴨|かも}{肉|にく}→鴨肉：noentry⟧)
- アヒル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧: duckling
- ⟦{合鴨|あいがも}→合鴨：noentry⟧: crossbreed of wild and domestic duck
- ⟦{白鳥|はくちょう}→白鳥：04937_hakuchou⟧: swan

ONOMATOPOEIA:
- ガーガー: quacking sound
- よちよち: waddling motion (アヒル⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ — duck walk)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The story 「⟦{醜|みにく}い→醜い：00281_minikui⟧アヒル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧」 (The Ugly Duckling) is well known in Japan. Rubber ducks (アヒル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おもちゃ→おもちゃ：01334_omocha⟧) are also a familiar bath toy.
